description:
Stuck on a skip? Step-by-step voice guide with UPDATED skips: https://youtu.be/ESrrkdxD1fo
LATEST PATCH 1.0.1 Kuldra speedrun in RuneScape: Dragonwilds with the new skips that work after the patch. Get your Dragon armour fast with this route.

No commentary. Follow along step by step, or use the chapters to jump straight to the skip you need.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Start
0:18 Windstep to air anima
0:40 Soulscourge skip
1:17 Skip the black dragon
1:35 Skip the ENTIRE necromancer area (NEW)
2:40 Skip the ENTIRE poison area
3:04 Surge + phase dash past the abyssal demon
3:40 Skip the HARDEST part of the raid (NEW) (Even faster way is killing the Garou Thane in the air room through the gate with a melee weapon, getting air charged from killing him then windstepping up through the air doorway) - thanks  @Sir_Rebral  
5:20 Parkour section made easy
6:00 Elemental puzzle (NO MORE SKIP)
8:25 Skip the Kuldra fight in under a minute
9:24 Kuldra's heart: where to stand (no heartworms)

GEAR & SETUP
- Fleet Foot Infusion: MUST BRING. Cuts sprinting stamina cost by 50%.
- Strong Tea: nice to have, restores +20 Rest.
- Mage weapon: 2-handed mage staff for killing the heart at the end.
- Armour: best mage gear you have.

What's your best Kuldra time? Drop it in the comments. And tell me which skip you didn't know about. If this saved you time, drop a subscribe, I'll be dropping an updated video with every patch! Trying to hit 500 subs!

comments.author: @damezup
comments.text:
You can do the last room before kuldra, the one  with the 4 element things, faster. 

Go left first, then while you’re waiting for the first fire thing, pop surge and tempest shield, and then when you go to use the red charge on the red pylon, use the surge to distract 2 of the 3 dudes, then stand on the fire seal thing again and get another fire charge, and use the tempest shield to avoid most of the damage from the one guy who doesn’t get confused, then you can run back across the pipes with a charge for the anima orb to open up the air one, then you just go grab one air charge and you’re done. That way you only need to run left once and right once, instead of all the back and forth. 

And if you don’t confuse the guardian in the room right before it, you can confuse the guardian on the left of the next room in the fire charge are who doesn’t get distracted by the surge hologram thingy, so that he doesn’t mess with you at all. I forget if that makes the guardian from the previous room too annoying to deal with, or if he loses aggro, or if you can just run around him; it’s been a while since I tried it, and I can’t check now so maybe you can look into it, maybe find something even better to shave off some seconds here and there.
